gloss: background; backing, support; to reverse (a vehicle)

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: バックしませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: バックしていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: バックしていませんでした

definitions.explanation: The background or backdrop of a scene, or the support behind a person or project. From English "back."
The act of driving a vehicle in reverse. Used as a suru verb: バックする.

examples.japanese: バックに{山|やま}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see mountains in the background.

examples.japanese: あの{政治家|せいじか}には{大|おお}きな{企業|きぎょう}がバックについている。
examples.english: That politician has a large corporation backing him.

examples.japanese: {夕焼|ゆうや}けをバックに{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a photo with the sunset in the background.

examples.japanese: ゆっくりバックしてください。
{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}でバックするときは{後方|こうほう}{確認|かくにん}を{忘|わす}れずに。
examples.english: Don't forget to check behind you when backing up in a parking lot.

examples.japanese: {狭|せま}い{道|みち}で{対向車|たいこうしゃ}が{来|き}たので、バックして{道|みち}を{譲|ゆず}った。
examples.english: A car came from the opposite direction on a narrow road, so I backed up to let it pass.

notes:
USAGE:
バック has several distinct uses in Japanese. As a background/support word, it often appears in the pattern ～をバックに (with ~ as a backdrop) or バックがつく (to have backing). As a driving term, バックする is the standard way to say "to reverse" a vehicle.

NOTE ON MEANING:
バック does not mean "bag" in Japanese — that word is バッグ (baggu). The two are commonly confused by learners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～をバックに: with ~ in the background
- バックがつく: to gain backing/support
- バックする: to reverse (a vehicle)
- バックミラー: rearview mirror
- バック{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}: reverse parking
